_schema.label: display name (EN + AR)
_schema.swap_for_arabic: true = left/right are the ENGLISH-thesis values; an Arabic thesis (--lang ar or Arabic title) gets them swapped so the wide binding margin sits on the right
_schema.mirror_margins: true = Word mirror margins (inside/outside) for two-sided printing
_schema.ar_spacing: Arabic body spacing when it differs
_schema.refs_spacing: reference-list spacing when the guide asks for single
_schema.chapter_space_before_cm: extra space above a chapter title (JUST wants a 5 cm top margin on chapter-title pages)

page_numbers.position: bottom-center | bottom-right | bottom-left | top-center | top-right | top-left
page_numbers.front_matter: roman | ROMAN | abjad | auto (roman for EN, abjad for AR) | none
page_numbers.title_page_number: true = the cover shows its number

_schema.cover: ordered list of front-matter fields: logo, university, faculty, department, title, author, supervisor, co_supervisor, statement, degree, program, affiliation, course, instructor, year, date, copyright, or any other key of the --- block
_schema.cover_labels: false = no By / Supervisor label lines
_schema.cover_space_before_lines: blank lines above the title (APA: title in the upper half)
_schema.notes: rules this script cannot apply automatically; the agent tells the user
_schema.verified: true only when the guide itself was read
_schema.verification: what was read and what was NOT found in the guide

ju.label: University of Jordan (الجامعة الأردنية)
ju.statement_en: This Thesis was Submitted in Partial Fulfillment of the Requirements for the {degree}
ju.statement_ar: قدمت هذه الرسالة استكمالاً لمتطلبات الحصول على درجة {degree}
ju.refs_style: author-year (the guide's own system, APA-like: family name, year in parentheses; list ordered alphabetically by first author)
ju.notes: Max 250 pages excluding appendices. Arabic 14 body / 16 main headings, English 12 body / 14 main headings, equations 12 or smaller. Thesis title and chapter titles bold. Headings, table titles and references single-spaced with a double space between references. Table title above the table, figure title below. Page number centred at the TOP; no number on the title page and the signature page; roman numerals (i, ii) for English front matter, abjad letters (أ، ب، ج) for Arabic; body numbering starts at the introduction. An authorization (تفويض) page precedes the title page: add it yourself. Footnotes separated from the text by a 3.5 cm rule. 'Arabic Transparent' is an old Windows font: if Word substitutes it, pass --ar-font 'Simplified Arabic' and tell the user.
ju.verification: Deans Council decision 'مواصفات كتابة الرسائل الجامعية' (43 pages, undated, sample title page May 2007) read on pages 1-5 rendered as images: paper, page limit, fonts, sizes, spacing, margins, numbering, title-page order, reference style. The binding side for Arabic theses is given as 'جهة التجليد' (the binding side), which this preset takes as the right edge for Arabic and the left for English. The site blocks plain fetchers (F5 'Request Rejected'); a full browser header set was needed.

yarmouk.label: Yarmouk University (جامعة اليرموك)
yarmouk.refs_style: author-year as laid out in the guide (family name, year in parentheses; alphabetical list)
yarmouk.notes: Guide rules read: A4; 1.5 spacing for Arabic, double for English; 3.5 cm on the binding side (right for Arabic copies, left for foreign-language copies), 2.5 cm elsewhere; front matter (title page to abstract) numbered with abjad letters (أ، ب، جـ) starting at the title page; title page order: title, 'إعداد' + full name, 'إشراف' + supervisor and co-supervisor, field of specialisation (put it in 'program:'), submission date (day, month, year); a committee page follows; abstract 350 words (MA) or 400 (PhD) as ONE paragraph, then up to 8 keywords; an abstract in the other language is required. NOT stated in the guide: font names and sizes, page-number position (skill defaults used: Simplified Arabic 14 / Times New Roman 12, bottom centre).
yarmouk.verification: 'دليل كتابة الرسائل والأطروحات الجامعية في جامعة اليرموك' (Deanship of Research and Graduate Studies, 2007/2008 edition, 44 pages, file dated 2015) read in full text after NFKC-normalising its presentation-form glyphs. Fonts and page-number position are absent from the guide.

just.label: Jordan University of Science and Technology (جامعة العلوم والتكنولوجيا الأردنية)
just.statement_en: Thesis submitted in partial fulfillment of the requirements for the degree of {degree}\nAt\nThe Faculty of Graduate Studies
just.refs_style: not stated in the template; follow the Faculty regulations page it links to
just.notes: From the official MSc Thesis Template: Times New Roman, double spacing, full justification; THESIS TITLE bold, all capitals, centred, 18 pt; DEDICATION, ACKNOWLEDGMENT, TABLE OF CONTENTS, LIST OF FIGURES/TABLES/ABBREVIATIONS, ABSTRACT headings 16 pt capitals; chapter titles on a new page, 16 pt, left-aligned, Title Case; section titles 14 pt bold, sub-sections 12 pt bold (deeper levels not bold); margins top 2.5 / bottom 2.5 / left 3 / right 2.5 cm, and 5 cm top on chapter-title pages (this preset adds 2.5 cm of space above each chapter title to reproduce that); page numbers centred in the footer; front matter in roman numerals. Cover order: TITLE, By, name, Advisor, name, Co-Advisor, name, statement, 'At', 'The Faculty of Graduate Studies', 'Jordan University of Science and Technology', 'Month, Year'. A signature/committee page and an Arabic تفويض page follow the cover: add them yourself. Arabic font is not specified in the template (theme 'majorBidi'); Simplified Arabic is this skill's default.
just.verification: The Faculty of Graduate Studies' own MSc Thesis Template (.docx, 2.1 MB) was downloaded and read with python-docx: section page size and margins, docDefaults (12 pt), footer page-number fields (centred), pgNumType (lowerRoman front matter), and its 'General Thesis Instructions' chapter quoted verbatim. The regulations page it cites (Regulations.aspx) was not fetched.

ksu.label: King Saud University (جامعة الملك سعود)
ksu.statement_en: A thesis submitted in partial fulfillment of the requirements for the {degree}\nMajor in {program}
ksu.refs_style: discipline's own style; references single-spaced with a blank line between entries, none split across pages
ksu.notes: Deanship of Graduate Studies guidelines: 12 pt Times New Roman throughout; double spacing except inset quotations, footnotes, tables and the reference list; text LEFT-justified, paragraphs tab-indented; margins left 1.5 in (binding), others 1.0 in; page size 21.59 x 27.94 cm (US Letter); page numbers top right inside the 1-inch margin; front matter in lowercase roman, title page counted but unnumbered, acceptance page = ii; body from 1. Order: Title Page, Acceptance Page, Dedication, ACKNOWLEDGMENTS, CONTENTS, ABBREVIATIONS, LIST OF FIGURES, LIST OF TABLES, ABSTRACT, narrative, APPENDIX, References, ARABIC ABSTRACT, Arabic Title Page (the last two at the END: add them yourself). Title and all section titles in CAPITAL LETTERS, not bold. Title page: TITLE, author, 'A (thesis/dissertation) submitted in partial fulfillment of the requirements for the (Degree Type)', 'Major in (Program)', 'King Saud University', 'YYYY (G)/ YYYY (H)'. Abstract page: ABSTRACT, title in capitals, author in capitals, year; max 350 words. Arabic font is not specified in the guide.
ksu.verification: 'Below are the Graduate School guidelines for formatting your thesis or dissertation' (Deanship of Graduate Studies, 6 pages, created 20 Nov 2025) read in full text. No Arabic-language rules in it.

qu.label: Qatar University (جامعة قطر)
qu.refs_style: the discipline's style manual; APA when the college names none; reference list double-spaced
qu.notes: Office of Graduate Studies template (March 2016): double spacing throughout; 12 pt; title and chapter headings may be larger but not above 16 pt; bold allowed for headings; 1.25 in margin on all sides; every page counted; lowercase roman for front matter, body starts at page 1; title page = i (not shown), committee page ii, abstract iii; page numbers lower right only; each chapter and each front-matter element on a new page; four blank lines before and after a table or figure (not automated); table captions above and left-aligned, figure captions below, no bold; abstract max 350 words; appendices lettered A, B, C. Title page: QATAR UNIVERSITY, COLLEGE NAME, TITLE (capitals, double-spaced), BY, name as on the transcript, statement, 'Month and Year' of conferral (June or January), copyright line '© year Name. All Rights Reserved.' (put it in 'copyright:'). A committee page follows: add it yourself. Paper size is not stated; the template PDF itself is US Letter, which this preset follows. The 2016 template is the newest one found; confirm with the Office of Graduate Studies.
qu.verification: 'THESIS/DISSERTATION FORMAT AND LAYOUT' + sample pages (12 pages, March 2016) read in full text. Fonts other than '12-point' and paper size are not named in it.

uaeu.label: United Arab Emirates University (جامعة الإمارات العربية المتحدة)
uaeu.refs_style: APA 7 (assumed; confirm with the College of Graduate Studies)
uaeu.notes: UNVERIFIED: based on common practice. The College of Graduate Studies publishes Word templates and a formatting guide only on its SharePoint portal (login required, HTTP 401 for outsiders); the public pages are workshop announcements that say the templates are mandatory. Ask the student for the current CGS template and match it; every value here is a conservative default (A4, 2.54 cm, binding +1 cm, Simplified Arabic 14 / Times New Roman 12, 1.5 spacing).
uaeu.verification: Only the public CGS workshop page was readable; it links the templates at https://alumniuaeuac.sharepoint.com/sites/cgs/Pages/thesis.aspx which returned 401.

cairo.label: Cairo University (جامعة القاهرة)
cairo.refs_style: set by the faculty (APA is common in the social sciences; Vancouver/numbered in medicine and engineering): confirm
cairo.notes: UNVERIFIED: based on common practice. No university-wide Cairo University formatting guide was found online; rules are set per faculty. The only document found is an unofficial Overleaf template that says it follows the Faculty of Engineering post-graduate office guidelines of July 2019: inner margin 3.54 cm, outer 2.54, top and bottom 2.54, 12 pt, chapters start on odd pages, Arabic cover as a separate page. Those numbers coincide with the conservative defaults used here. Ask the student's faculty for its own guide.
cairo.verification: cu.edu.eg graduate-studies pages did not respond; the Overleaf CUFE template is third-party and faculty-specific.

mutah.label: Mutah University (جامعة مؤتة)
mutah.statement_en: A thesis submitted to the College of Graduate Studies in partial fulfillment of the requirements of {degree}
mutah.statement_ar: قدمت هذه الرسالة استكمالاً لمتطلبات الحصول على درجة {degree}
mutah.refs_style: APA (all theses) except Law, History, Arabic and Sharia, which use footnotes (family name, first name, year, title in bold, publisher, place, page)
mutah.notes: College of Graduate Studies guide (2025): cover shows the college emblem, title (20 pt), student and supervisor names (18 pt), the 'in partial fulfillment' statement (16 pt), university and year. Arabic theses: Simplified Arabic 16 in all disciplines (Arabic, Law, Sharia, History: 16 body / 14 footnotes), headings same font in bold; English theses: Times New Roman 14 including numerals, headings bold; TOC and lists of tables/figures/appendices at 14 (Arabic) / 12 (English) (this preset keeps body sizes there). Main headings, table and figure titles and references single-spaced; one blank line before and after headings; body spacing is NOT stated (1.5 used). Margins 2.5 cm all round except the binding side 3.5 cm (right for Arabic, left for English). Front matter order: cover, disclaimer (الآراء الواردة...), approval page, dedication, acknowledgements, contents, list of tables, list of figures, list of appendices, abstract (Arabic first for Arabic theses, English first for English theses). Arabic theses: front matter أ، ب، ج; English theses: roman numerals; body 1, 2, 3. Chapter headings on new pages; a sentence never starts with a numeral or abbreviation; abbreviations spelled out at first use and listed in the introduction. Abstract max 250 words with title, author, 'Mutah University, year' above it. Paper size and page-number position are not stated (A4, bottom centre used).
mutah.source_url: https://www.mutah.edu.jo/ar/GraduateStudies/Forms/دليل كتابة الرسائل الجامعية في جامعة مؤتة-جديد.pdf
mutah.verification: 'دليل كتابة الرسائل الجامعية في جامعة مؤتة' (College of Graduate Studies, 2025, 20 pages) read in full text: cover, fonts, spacing, margins, front-matter order, numbering, chapter scheme, abstract, TOC sample, APA examples.

generic-arab.label: Generic Arab university thesis (رسالة جامعية عربية، إعدادات شائعة)
generic-arab.notes: UNVERIFIED: based on common practice, not on any one university's guide. Conservative values: A4, 2.54 cm margins with 1 cm more on the binding side (right for Arabic, left for English), Simplified Arabic 14 / Times New Roman 12, 1.5 spacing, front matter in abjad letters (Arabic) or roman numerals (English), body from 1. The verified Jordanian guides (ju, yarmouk, mutah) all use 3.5 / 2.5 cm; use one of them when the university is known.
generic-arab.verification: Not a university guide; a safe default to hand to a supervisor for confirmation.

apa7.label: APA 7 student paper (manuscript for a course or a journal)
apa7.notes: Standard-sized paper 8.5 x 11 in; 1 in margins on all sides; accepted fonts: 12 pt Times New Roman, 11 pt Calibri, 11 pt Arial, 11 pt Georgia, 10 pt Lucida Sans Unicode, 10 pt Computer Modern, used consistently; double spacing throughout including the title page; page number flush right in the header of every page; student papers carry no running head (professional papers: title in capitals flush left + page number); student title page: title (bold, upper half of the page), author, affiliation, course number and name, instructor, due date, no author note. Level 1 headings centred bold, Level 2 flush-left bold (this preset); use --preset apa7 together with --lang en for an English manuscript. Left alignment (ragged right) follows APA 7 section 2.23, which was not re-read today.
apa7.verification: Purdue OWL 'General Format' page read (apastyle.apa.org pages render empty to a fetcher). Heading-level formatting comes from the OWL 'Headings and Seriation' page, not re-read today.
